name: net_prologue_party_skip
description: PC1, two instances. Relay and both runtimes connect at the title; both games start NEW GAME with the default rows. The host plays the opening (Cross only while its own field gate is closed and no menu is open); the friend is held at its own blocked opening exit and follows the host's first prologue field. Checks: both seats declare and acknowledge Roxas during the opening; the first-field barrier releases on both with two P_EX110 and two weapons each; owner-only movement seen from both seats; one synthetic hit per seat leaves the other seat's HP and SAVE ranges unchanged; the Armor Shop event's same-room reload (evt95 -> evt97) rebinds both seats before control returns; the Day 1 lock-on tutorial (Accessory Shop talk, evt99, cat lock-on) takes the first room change to the Sandlot, where both seats are rebuilt, no field was left unheld and movement stays owner-only. Never saves. Development variant: cutscenes skipped natively (Start, Down, Cross).
